name: Umbral Offering
body:
School abjuration [shadow]; Level bloodlord 4, death mage 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, white necromancer 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a sacrificial living creature or other suitable sacrifice)

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets 1 willing touched creature/caster level
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw none; see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You complete the sacrifice and anoint each creature to be protected with some part of the sacrifice, typically blood or ash, leaving the rest to the denizens of the plane of shadow. For the duration the protected 33 creatures gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (planes), Knowledge (religion), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks while in the plane of shadow or regarding creatures with the shadow subtype, and light spells cast by affected creatures are not impeded on the plane of shadow. The effects of this spell stack with the favored terrain ability. Additionally, any creature with the shadow subtype begins with a neutral disposition and will not run from nor attack a protected creature, unless attacked first or impelled by some outside means. This spell cannot be used for urban terrain. Any intelligent creature gets a Will save to negate the effects of the impelled peace and neutrality.
